newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to move Palo Verde electricity futures close.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to move Palo Verde electricity futures close.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Wednesday it will change the closing time of its Palo Verde electricity futures and options contracts to 1525 EST, five minutes ahaed of the current 1530 EST close.
The change will take effect December 16, NYMEX said.
California Oregon Border futures and options contracts will continue to close at 1530 EST, NYMEX said.
"This change will allow market users and members the flexibility of participating in the close for both contracts," NYMEX president Patrick Thompson said in a statement.
